theorem plus_one_at_most_two_pow (n : ℕ) (h : 1 ≤ n) : n + 1 ≤ 2 ^ n :=
begin
  -- 1. 2 to the power of n is always greater than or equal to 2.
  have h2_pow_n_ge_2 : 2 ^ n ≥ 2, by
    { induction n with n ih,
      { exact dec_trivial },
      { exact (pow_two n).ge.trans (ih.trans (pow_two_pos n)) } },
  
  -- 2. n + 1 is at least 2 for any natural number n.
  have h_n_plus_1_ge_2 : n + 1 ≥ 2, by
    { exact (add_one_ge n).trans (ge_of_le_add_left h) },
  
  -- 3. 2 to the power of n is at least n + 1.
  have h2_pow_n_ge_n_plus_1 : 2 ^ n ≥ n + 1, by
    { exact (ge_of_le_trans h2_pow_n_ge_2 h_n_plus_1_ge_2) },
  
  -- 4. If a is at least b and c is at least b, then a is at least c.
  have h_if_ge_ge_ge : ∀ {a b c : ℕ}, a ≥ b → c ≥ b → a ≥ c, by
    { intros a b c hab hbc,
      exact (ge_of_le_trans hab hbc) },
  
  -- 5. 2 to the power of n is at least n + 1, which means that n + 1 is at most 2 to the power of n.
  have h_n_plus_1_le_2_pow_n : n + 1 ≤ 2 ^ n, by
    { exact (h_if_ge_ge_ge h2_pow_n_ge_n_plus_1 h2_pow_n_ge_2) },
  
  -- 6. n + 1 is at most 2 to the power of n for any natural number n.
  exact h_n_plus_1_le_2_pow_n
end
